entries.title: Psalms 83:1
segments: ¶<A Song. A Psalm. Of Asaph.> O God, do not keep quiet: let your lips be open and take no rest, O God.

entries.title: Psalms 83:2
segments: For see! those who make war on you are out of control; your haters are lifting up their heads.

entries.title: Psalms 83:3
segments: They have made wise designs against your people, talking together against those whom you keep in a secret place.

entries.title: Psalms 83:4
segments: They have said, Come, let us put an end to them as a nation; so that the name of Israel may go out of man's memory.

entries.title: Psalms 83:5
segments: For they have all come to an agreement; they are all joined together against you:

entries.title: Psalms 83:6
segments: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagarites;

entries.title: Psalms 83:7
segments: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek; the Philistines and the people of Tyre;

entries.title: Psalms 83:8
segments: Assur is joined with them; they have become the support of the children of Lot. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 83:9
segments: ¶Do to them what you did to the Midianites; what you did to Sisera and Jabin, at the stream of Kishon:

entries.title: Psalms 83:10
segments: Who came to destruction at En-dor; their bodies became dust and waste.

entries.title: Psalms 83:11
segments: Make their chiefs like Oreb and Zeeb; and all their rulers like Zebah and Zalmunna:

entries.title: Psalms 83:12
segments: Who have said, Let us take for our heritage the resting-place of God.

entries.title: Psalms 83:13
segments: O my God, make them like the rolling dust; like dry stems before the wind.

entries.title: Psalms 83:14
segments: As fire burning a wood, and as a flame causing fire on the mountains,

entries.title: Psalms 83:15
segments: So go after them with your strong wind, and let them be full of fear because of your storm.

entries.title: Psalms 83:16
segments: Let their faces be full of shame; so that they may give honour to your name, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 83:17
segments: Let them be overcome and troubled for ever; let them be put to shame and come to destruction;

entries.title: Psalms 83:18
segments: So that men may see that you only, whose name is Yahweh, are Most High over all the earth.
